title: Kissinger's 1977 Moon Dust telegram to Ottawa

tellings.quote: In January of 1977, just before leaving office, Kissinger sent a telegram to the US embassy in Ottawa requesting a report on quote unquote possible returned space [music] objects.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in January 1977, just before leaving office, Henry Kissinger, the American statesman, sent a telegram to the US embassy in Ottawa, Canada, asking for a report on "possible returned space objects." Michels notes that its subject line was Moon Dust, the name of a US effort to recover objects that fell from space. He tells it because, if it means what he thinks, it ties Kissinger to the recovery of fallen craft.
